_comment: Per-repository additions to the card. Optional: a repository absent from this file still
gets a card, drawn entirely from its GitHub metadata.
install — the one thing no generated card can ever show, because GitHub has nowhere to keep
it. For something you install and run it is the most useful line on the card. Every command
here is copied from that repository's own README and is the first one a reader is given;
re-check it when the README changes, because nothing else will.
theme  — light or dark, overriding the run default. LIGHT IS THE DEFAULT AND NOTHING
CURRENTLY OVERRIDES IT. The mechanism exists because calvin.sg genuinely has two themes,
but a card is a static PNG and has to pick one, and light wins on two counts that are
about the card rather than about taste: it carries the brand's real ink (primary-600
#A82334, which the site only uses in Latte — the dark theme's #F3A3AA is an accommodation
for a dark ground), and it makes the install chip the single dark element on the card, so
the one line meant to be copied is the one that pulls the eye. On a dark card that chip
disappears into its background. Reach for dark when a specific repository has a reason
visible on the card, not a mood — and render both before deciding.

calvindotsg/homebrew-tap.install: brew tap calvindotsg/tap && brew trust --tap calvindotsg/tap
